title: 最后一枚
brief: One silver-haired girl, simple paper sticker, exaggerated blank circular eyes and purple sleeveless workout costume. Turns out her pocket, a single coin drops, rolls past; eyes track it, delayed aghast reaction, bends down out of crop to recover, returns upright. No markings/text on coin.

board.title: 最后一枚
poses: 0.0 s: Draw a silver-haired girl with huge blank circular eyes and a purple sleeveless workout costume as a simple paper sticker; her right hand rests inside her right pocket, and her left hand rests on her hip.
0.5 s: She pulls her right pocket inside out with her right hand while her left steadies the waistband; one plain, unmarked coin drops from the pocket.
1.0 s: The coin lands on its edge near the lower center and rolls right; she tips her face downward to track it, keeping both hands on the pocket and waistband.
1.5 s: The coin rolls through the lower-right foreground toward the crop edge; her head turns farther right, her blank eyes following, while her expression stays neutral.
2.1 s: The coin has rolled out of view; she finally opens her mouth in aghast disbelief, raises her shoulders, and freezes with both hands still holding their previous positions.
2.7 s: She releases the pocket and bends toward the lower-right foreground, reaching down with her right hand while her left hand slides onto her left thigh for support.
3.3 s: Her head, shoulders, and reaching right hand dip below the bottom crop to retrieve the coin; her bent hips and left hand braced on her thigh remain visible.
3.9 s: She returns upright holding the same plain coin between her right thumb and forefinger; her left hand lifts the right pocket opening, and her face points toward the coin.
4.5 s: She presses the coin completely into the restored pocket, leaving her right fingertips at its opening as her left hand releases it and her expression settles.
board.continuity: Use one fixed camera and consistent sticker styling throughout a 4.8-second loop, preserving the single coin and hand paths as pose nine flows into the distinct first pose.
